sentence: This project builds neural network surrogates that stand in for slow numerical models of ocean current circulation along coasts.
This project gathers experts to study how institutions can keep information trustworthy as machine-generated content becomes abundant.
This project builds a mathematical model of a migrating cell to find out how forces inside the cell respond to its surroundings.
This project develops autonomous aerial systems that perform wildfire monitoring during prescribed burns in hazardous environments.
This project studies how cyanobacteria in the diet affect disease caused by parasites in Daphnia living in ponds.
This project builds a high-performance computing system to help researchers study natural hazards, critical minerals and climate change.
This project uses a physically-based model to study how recent increases in precipitation changed streamflow and flooding in a cold region.
This project develops compressed indexes that keep highly compressible data small while still allowing it to be searched.
This project builds open-source software that gives developers one shared layer for working with many kinds of quantum computing hardware.
This project provides a measurement system for precise probing of microchips, materials, devices and systems.
This project supports a workshop on how quantum computers can simulate open quantum systems, which interact with their environment.
This project builds memristors from 2D nanomaterials as hardware for artificial neural networks emulating biological neuronal functions.
This project builds graphene-based biosensors that detect several biomolecules at once, using neurotransmitters as a testbed.
This project studies how fruit fly sperm take on a needle-like shape and enter eggs, using genes required for sperm function.
This project develops control methods that let wave energy converters work together and keep the electric grid stable.
This project studies the genetic diversity of beech trees and looks for genetic signs of resistance to disease.
